name: DC-DEADCAST
description: A performance-focused Dreamcast emulator with recomp modules.
author: tyrannotorus

changelog.1.2.0:
- In-app Recomp Store
- Per-module settings and button remapping
- A failing recomp module offers the emulator core
- Older recomp modules must be updated from the store
- Flycast's menus and RetroAchievements removed
changelog.1.1.1:
- Most games tested run at nearly full speed on Brick hardware
- The screen refreshes at close to the Dreamcast's 59.94 Hz instead of 60.2 Hz
- Save-state pictures are no longer garbled
- Daytona USA: car decals display correctly
- New: Delete Recomp Module (Options > Recomp Options) removes the module, its saves and its settings
- An interrupted module install is cleaned up at the next start
- Rez recomp module 1.0.2: opening the menu no longer shows garbled graphics
